description: This file defines the LogCatLogProvider class, which implements the LogProvider interface to send log messages to Android's LogCat. It provides methods for various log levels such as verbose, debug, info, warning, error, and wtf, all of which are supported in this implementation. The class is intended for use in DEBUG builds of the application.

classes.name: LogCatLogProvider
classes.description: Implements LogProvider to route log messages to Android's LogCat, supporting all log levels.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message to LogCat.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message to LogCat.

methods.name: supportsYell
methods.description: Indicates support for custom 'yell' level logging.

methods.name: yell
methods.description: Logs a warning message with '-YELL' suffix to LogCat.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message to LogCat.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message to LogCat.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message to LogCat.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a WTF (assert) message to LogCat.
